source.title: Updated determination of the molar gas constant R by acoustic measurements in argon at UVa-CEM
source.selection_rule: Lowest listed Table 1 pressure within the stated 60-600 kPa acoustic range; selected before generation.
source.point_locator: Table 1, PDF page 22; sections 2.2 and 2.3, PDF pages 7-10

temperature_K.interpretation: TPW reference isotherm; measurements are corrected to this reference, not each instantaneous thermometer reading

pressure_Pa.interpretation: 0.08090 MPa tabulated pressure; not raw gauge samples

conditional_survey_assumptions.density_relation: n_proxy=p/(k_B*T); Z=1 is ASSUMED, not a measured density or verified EOS
conditional_survey_assumptions.species_mapping: pure Ar40 proxy is ASSUMED; the sample isotope composition is unknown
conditional_survey_assumptions.momentum_law: classical equilibrium Maxwell-Boltzmann proxy is ASSUMED, not a measured velocity distribution
conditional_survey_assumptions.boundary: cube is an initial placement frame only; no walls, PBC or dynamics
